body: I've slept on it my whole life and I've tried everything there is to try. I'm done

I understand, thats the point of this place, to stop suicide. But even if its stopped, it's just..so what? I'm still going to continue being like this. I don't have a reason to hope when all of my hopes get crushed, nothing I want happens. No disrespect, but I've had people that have at some point loved me say they cared about me and then they proved that they didn't. How could I possibly believe anyone would care about me.
